title: Tenure Goodwill Credit for Long-Held Waivers
content:
## Tenure goodwill credit for long-held Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda

A refund released to the holder receives a goodwill credit for the holder's tenure, which is whole calendar months from the waiver's sale date to the effective date of the waiver's ending (the waiver's closing date). A whole calendar month counts each time the sale date's day of the month is reached; an end date on an earlier day of the month does not complete the month, and there is no month-end adjustment.

| Holder's tenure | Goodwill credit added to the holder release |
|---|---|
| 36 months or more | 15.00 |
| 24 to 35 months | 8.00 |
| Under 24 months | None |

The credit is added to the holder release after the holder late interest has been rounded to the cent, and the release total is rounded half up to the cent.

### Counting tenure (hypothetical dates)

- Sold 14 June of Year 1, ending effective 14 June of Year 4: 36 months, credit 15.00.
- Sold 14 June of Year 1, ending effective 13 June of Year 4: 35 months, credit 8.00.
- Sold 31 January of Year 1, ending effective 28 February of Year 3: the 31st is never reached in February, so February does not complete a further month and there is no month-end adjustment; the tenure is 24 months (the 24th month was completed on 31 January of Year 3), credit 8.00.
- Sold 3 May of Year 1, ending effective 2 May of Year 3: 23 months, no credit.
